hooks.command:
mkdir -p .claude 2>/dev/null
state=".claude/.readme-hook-state"
changes=$( { git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude)README.md' ':(exclude).claude' 2>/dev/null; git diff -- . ':(exclude)README.md' ':(exclude).claude' 2>/dev/null; } )
if [ -z "$changes" ]; then exit 0; fi
hash=$(printf '%s' "$changes" | git hash-object --stdin 2>/dev/null)
last=""
[ -f "$state" ] && last=$(cat "$state")
if [ "$hash" = "$last" ]; then exit 0; fi
printf '%s' "$hash" > "$state"
printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Files changed this turn. If any of these changes affect functionality, behavior, CLI/API, config, or setup steps (not just formatting, comments, tests, or non-README docs), update README.md to reflect them before finishing."}'
